spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Minimalist IDE approach. Dense but highly structured, similar to Linear or Vercel.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Control Room Grid (Dense, functional, no empty useless spaces).
spacing_and_layout.gaps: gap-4 for major panels, gap-2 for inner items.
spacing_and_layout.paddings: p-4 or p-6 for major panels, p-2 or p-3 for inner cards.
spacing_and_layout.radii: rounded-md (6px) for panels, rounded-sm (4px) for inner elements. Avoid pill shapes (rounded-full) for main UI elements.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid #262626 everywhere. No gradients, no soft shadows.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: None. Use 1px borders for separation instead of shadows to keep it flat and minimal.

chat_interface.style: Clean message bubbles. No colored backgrounds for user vs bot, use subtle background differences (e.g., transparent vs #171717) and 1px borders. Left aligned.
chat_interface.input: Flat textarea, 1px border (#262626), ring-0 focus. Submit button inside input.

live_preview.style: Full height panel. Top header bar with URL/Refresh separated by 1px bottom border. Iframe below.

terminal_tab.style: Monospace font. Absolute bottom panel or bottom tab. Darkest background (#000000).

modals.style: Flat panel. bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl for overlay. Modal itself should be solid #0a0a0a with 1px border #262626.

buttons.primary: bg-zinc-50 text-black hover:bg-zinc-200. Flat, no shadow.

motion.philosophy: Instant feedback, very fast transitions (150ms). No excessive animations.
motion.hover: Subtle background color change or text color change. No scaling (no hover:scale).
motion.modals: Fade in, scale from 98% to 100% fast (150ms).

images.philosophy: As an IDE tool, minimal to no images are needed. Rely on icons and typography.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor .js and UI components to remove all 'glow', 'shadow-xl', gradients, and highly saturated colors.
Implement a pure flat minimalist style: #000000 backgrounds, #171717 panels, 1px #262626 borders.
Remove excess decorations. Ensure high contrast typography (white text on black/dark grey).
Ensure 'Live Preview', 'Terminal', 'Chat Interface' follow a structured pane layout (using flex or react-resizable-panels) with clear 1px borders dividing them.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements to facilitate robust automated testing.
For components, heavily use Shadcn (customized to have no rounding or shadows, strictly flat with borders).
No purple (#9D4CDD) or teal (#1B93A4) anywhere. Keep colors muted except for a single focus/accent color if strictly necessary.
Ensure generous spacing inside containers, but maintain tight functional grids for tools.
